slug: 2020-06-17 Angola now using Chinese-devised civil registration system

facts.fact: Forum Macao, quoting Jornal de Angola and technical lead Fernando Fortes, reports that the Angolan authorities began using a new civil-registration system devised by China, with the aim of registering the births of 12 million Angolans by 2022; no start date is given, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: new civil-registration system devised by China

facts.fact: Forum Macao, quoting Jornal de Angola, says the new civil-registration system was rolled out first in Luanda and gives no count of offices using it; no date is given for the rollout, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: new civil-registration system devised by China

systems.system: new civil-registration system devised by China
systems.owner: the Angolan authorities (not named further); China National Electronics Import & Export Corp (CEIEC) won the contract to set it up in November 2019

systems.tiers: not stated; the civil-registration system supplies the birth-certificate copy used to apply for it
